decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line bug-fix title in the release notes [ev-5506a0d4614a], "bottlerocket settings taint format", plus a link to PR #6489. It doesn't say what the taint format was before or after the fix, which taints were affected (NodePool taints, startup taints or user-supplied Bottlerocket userData), or what an affected Bottlerocket node experienced. Without that, the applicability condition can't be written. The PR #6489 description or diff, or a docs/upgrade-guide passage explaining the format change, is needed.
